title: Sharp spectral Moon--Moser-type theorems in the linear range via feasible graph parameters
summary: Moon and Moser proved a sharp edge-extremal theorem for Hamilton cycles in balanced bipartite graphs with minimum degree at least $k$. Li and Ning obtained spectral analogues for Hamiltonicity in balanced bipartite graphs of order $2n$ and for traceability in nearly balanced bipartite graphs with part sizes $n$ and $n-1$, under the assumption $n\ge (k+1)^2$. We show that their sharp spectral thresholds remain valid in the linear ranges $n\ge 2k$ and $n\ge 2k+1$, respectively.
